queue.title: How to Write a monday.com Column Formula That Pre-Fills Your Proposal Fields Automatically
queue.brief: Most monday.com users build proposals by copy-pasting data from their boards—but the right column formulas can do that heavy lifting before a document is ever opened. This post shows you exactly which formula setups eliminate blank-field errors and speed up every client document you send.
queue.description: H2 sections cover: (1) Why blank or mismatched fields are the #1 delay in client documents, (2) The four monday.com column types that map cleanly to proposal fields (text, numbers, date, mirror), (3) Step-by-step formula column recipes for deal value, timeline, and scope summaries, (4) How to structure your board so document tools like DocuAI can pull clean data without manual cleanup, (5) A real-world example of an agency that cut proposal prep from 40 minutes to under five by fixing column hygiene first. Target keyword: "monday.com formula columns for proposals." The post is actionable for any monday.com user who sends client documents, and naturally shows DocuAI as the next step once columns are structured correctly.
